Claire Harrington
Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager
Boston, MA | claire.harrington@csmail.com | +1 617-555-0142 | linkedin.com/in/claireharrington-csm

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Strategic Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager with 7+ years of experience driving adoption, retention, and account expansion for B2B SaaS platforms. Proven track record managing $18M+ in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) across Fortune 500 accounts. Expert in conducting Executive Business Reviews (QBRs), customer onboarding, churn risk mitigation, and identifying up-sell/cross-sell opportunities, achieving a 118% Net Revenue Retention (NRR) rate.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Senior Enterprise CSM | CloudMetrics SaaS | Boston, MA | 2021 - Present
- Managed portfolio of 28 enterprise Fortune 500 accounts representing $18M in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR).
- Achieved 118% Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and 96% Gross Retention Rate (GRR) by orchestrating multi-tiered account health strategies in Gainsight.
- Delivered 60+ Quarterly Executive Business Reviews (QBRs) with C-suite and VP-level stakeholders, demonstrating measurable ROI and product value realization.
- Partnered with Sales and Account Executives to identify and close $2.8M in expansion and up-sell opportunities across existing accounts.
- Reduced customer onboarding time from 60 days to 28 days by designing a standardized 30-60-90 day milestone adoption framework.

Customer Success Manager | DataFlow Technologies | Cambridge, MA | 2018 - 2021
- Managed 45 mid-market and enterprise SaaS client accounts totaling $7.5M ARR with a 94% renewal rate.
- Created proactive customer health scoring models in Salesforce and Zendesk, identifying early churn indicators and saving 14 at-risk accounts ($1.1M ARR).
- Authored customer knowledge base articles, training webinars, and best-practice workflows, increasing product feature adoption by 42%.
- Collaborated with Product and Engineering teams to advocate for customer feature requests, prioritizing 8 major roadmap enhancements.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Business Management | Boston University | 2014 - 2018

TECHNICAL SKILLS
- CS Strategy & Methodologies: Customer Onboarding, Executive Business Reviews (QBRs), Churn Mitigation, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), Account Expansion, Stakeholder Management
- Software & Platforms: Gainsight, Salesforce CRM, Zendesk, ChurnZero, Totango, HubSpot, Catalyst, Slack, Zoom
- Analytics & Metrics: Customer Health Scoring, Gross Retention Rate (GRR), CSAT, Net Promoter Score (NPS), Product Usage Analytics (Mixpanel, Pendo)

CERTIFICATIONS
- Certified Customer Success Manager (CCSM) Level 3 - SuccessHACKER (2022)
- Salesforce Certified Administrator (2020)
jobDescriptionText:
Seeking a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager to manage high-value accounts. Requirements:
- 5+ years experience as a CSM managing enterprise B2B SaaS accounts ($10M+ ARR).
- Proven track record of high Net Revenue Retention (NRR > 110%) and gross retention.
- Strong proficiency in Gainsight, Salesforce, customer health scoring, and running executive QBRs.
- CCSM or Salesforce certification preferred.
